title: Gradual Independence and Responsibility
summary: Your child is growing and needs a wider space, but with boundaries. Transition from control to supervision: entrust them with real responsibilities (their allowance, duties, household tasks) and grant them trust conditioned on commitment. Responsibility given gradually builds maturity, while excessive protection delays it.
try_this: This week: Hand over to your child a new responsibility that one of you used to handle (organizing their bag or managing their weekly allowance).
reflection_prompts: Which responsibility can your child take on now?
How do you handle their mistakes in it?
